meaning_fixes.before: They were alive! And you're gonna let them die again!? Damn it!
meaning_fixes.after: They were alive! And now they are going to be left to die again!? Damn it!
meaning_fixes.reason: Source '今度も見殺しかよ！？' has no stated subject for who is doing the abandoning. The speaker (contextually Ryoko, continuing her reaction from rows 3305-3306/3309, immediately after Akito and Yurika are caught in an explosion) is not addressing a specific second person, so 'you're gonna let them die' invents a 'you' to blame that the source never names. Replaced with a passive construction that keeps the ambiguity, per the no-invented-subject rule.

checked_decisions.finding: Orchestrator ruling applied: '強化人間' (kyouka ningen) rendered 'Cyber Newtype', matching the existing character_names_021 description of this same archetype for Gyunei Guss. Ruling accepted as-is; no fix needed.
Hokushin kept as the locked name from character_names_021 (Martian Successors' assassination-unit leader); not respelled.

Amuro Ray, Renton, and Garrod (all named explicitly by the source) kept spelled per character_names_021; 'he' in 3334 correctly matches the source's own masculine pronoun for the Cyber Newtype enemy, not an assumption from a name.

'大佐' (Taisa/Colonel) kept as a generic unnamed rank, not expanded to 'Char Aznable'; this is a different rank from '大尉' (taii), so it falls outside the taii-to-'Captain' orchestrator ruling and is unaffected by it.

'Are you two working together!?' correctly addresses exactly two parties: the reply ('Don't lump us, the proud Neo Zeon, in with coup forces!') confirms two distinct forces are in view in this exchange, so 'two' is not an invented headcount.
艦長 (Ruri, this scene) consistently rendered 'Captain' per orchestrator ruling.

Berkt, Talho, Harry, Hoshino, and Akito Tenkawa all match character_names_021 spellings; color() tags kept exactly where the source has them (e.g. limited to the name span in 3353's reordered 'Captain Hoshino').
Baldora Charge book(2) tag matches encyclopedia_022's own rendering of the same term.
'He'/'the enemy'/'this' supplied only where the antecedent (Berkt, or the situation) is unambiguous from the immediately preceding line; no subject invented beyond what context settles.
Ruins Unit, Boson Jump, Neo Zeon, Giganos, and Martian Successors book() tags all match encyclopedia_022 entries; 'banded together' avoids the lowercase j in 'joined' without changing meaning.
The black machine's identity reveal (Akito Tenkawa, former Nadesico crewmate) is not disclosed early; 'that black machine' is kept ambiguous on row 3360 exactly as the source withholds it until 3361.
'仕事場' (job/workplace) rendered 'post' to avoid a lowercase j; speaker is self-referential ('オレ'), no third-party gender assigned.

uncertainties.issue: Speakers in rows 3310-3335 (Amaterasu's fall and the Londo Bell engagement) are untagged; only Renton and Garrod are named by the source itself, so no other speaker identity was written into any target. Row 3310's fix (see meaning_fixes) assumes an unspecified/passive subject rather than assigning the line to Ryoko outright, since that attribution is inference, not stated.

Rows 3336-3365 read as a joint debrief between the Nadesico B (Ruri, Harry) and the Gekko-Go (Talho); the source never names a single ship, so no vessel name was added. The unattributed closer at 3365 ('I'm coming along too, my post is gone anyway') is plausibly the mercenary/contractor introduced at rows 3252-3259 of the prior slice, but this was left out of the target as unconfirmed.
